title: ATR FTIR Spectroscopy of Aqueous Cell Cultures
author: Emrulla Spahiu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdidi4a6

steps.title: Set ambient temperature
steps.instruction: Adjust the laboratory environment to 25 °C before starting the measurements.

steps.title: Clean ATR crystal
steps.instruction: Wipe the ATR crystal with a cellulose wipe using a water‑ethanol‑water sequence, avoiding any scratches on the crystal surface.

steps.title: Configure instrument parameters
steps.instruction: On the Perkin Elmer ATR‑FTIR spectroscope, select “Scan and Instrument Setup”, enter the sample name, set scan range to 650–4000 cm⁻¹, number of scans to 128, and spectral resolution to 2 cm⁻¹ (optimize if needed for the specific sample).

steps.title: Acquire background spectrum
steps.instruction: Run a background scan to automatically subtract atmospheric H₂O and CO₂ interference using the software.

steps.title: Record PBS reference
steps.instruction: Measure a PBS sample, then manually subtract its spectrum from each subsequent sample to remove PBS interference and flatten the water band near 2125 cm⁻¹.

steps.title: Apply and dry cell sample
steps.instruction: Place 1 µL of the cell suspension onto the crystal and dry with a gentle N₂ flow for 5 minutes (00:05:00) to allow cells to settle.

steps.title: Collect sample spectra
steps.instruction: Scan the dried sample (≈7 minutes, 00:07:00). Perform three independent scans under identical conditions; the average of these three constitutes one replicate. Acquire five replicates (n = 5) for data analysis.

steps.title: Monitor scan quality
steps.instruction: During each scan ensure the quality‑check indicator remains green at all times.

steps.title: Export spectra to Unscrambler
steps.instruction: Save each spectrum as a data file and import into Unscrambler 11.0 (Camo, NO).

steps.title: Select spectral region
steps.instruction: Define the analysis window to the 650–3000 cm⁻¹ region.

steps.title: Perform PCA analysis
steps.instruction: Create a PCA model, use loading plots to identify high‑variation regions, and examine scores plots to assess replicate grouping and detect outliers.

steps.title: Label peaks and record
steps.instruction: Automatically label peaks, then manually determine each band’s centre of weight and frequency. Compare to literature (Movasaghi et al., Applied Spectroscopy Reviews). Compile an Excel sheet with peak positions and functional‑group assignments; use second‑derivative spectra for side‑peak assignments.

steps.title: Calculate concentrations
steps.instruction: Integrate the area under each peak to quantify concentrations.

steps.title: Measure bandwidths
steps.instruction: Manually measure bandwidths at 75 % of peak height for conformational alteration studies.
